40009210.author: पदार्थः
40009210.content: आर्तेन  by the distressed, रामेण by Rama, एवम् that way, उक्तः spoke, वानरः monkey, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, प्राञ्जलिः with folded palms, बाष्पगद्गदः voice choked, सबाष्पम् with sears, वाक्यम्  words, अब्रवीत् said

40009210.author: Translation
40009210.content: On hearing the words of Rama in deep distress, the monkey replied to him with folded hands, his throat choked with tears:

40009211.author: पदार्थः
40009211.content: दौष्कुलेयस्य born in despicable clan, तस्य his, पापरक्षसः of the sinful demon, निलयम् residence, सामर्थ्यम् capacity, विक्रमं वापि or his valour, कुलं वा or even the clan, सर्वथा all that, न जाने not known to me

40009211.author: Translation
40009211.content: 'I do not have any knowledge of this sinful demon's dwelling , his capability, his valour or his clan or his despicable lineage.

40009212.author: पदार्थः
40009212.content: अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies, सत्यम् truth, प्रतिजानामि I promise you, शोकम् sorrow, त्यज give up, मैथिलीम् Maithili, यथा as, प्राप्स्यसि will obtain, तथा that way, यत्नम् effort, करिष्यामि I will make

40009212.author: Translation
40009212.content: 'O subduer of enemies, give up sorrow. I promise I will make necessary effort so that you will obtain the princess from Mithila.

40009213.author: पदार्थः
40009213.content: सगणम् including clan, रावणम् Ravana, हत्वा after killing, आत्मपौरुषम् my prowess, परितोष्य satisfy, यथा as, प्रीतः pleased, भविष्यसि you will be, तथा that way, न चिरात् very soon, कर्तास्मि I will do

40009213.author: Translation
40009213.content: 'With all my capability I will kill Ravana and his clan. Thus I will be able to satisfy you soon with my efforts.

40009214.author: पदार्थः
40009214.content: वैक्लब्यम् despair, आलम्ब्य resorting to, अलम् it is enough, आत्मगतम् your natural disposition, धैर्यम् patience, स्मर pick up, त्वद्विधानाम् for men like you, ईदृशम् such, बुद्धिलाघवम् frivolous thought, न सदृशम् is not worthy

40009214.author: Translation
40009214.content: 'Give up despair. It is enough. Be patient. Maintain your natural disposition.It is unworthy of men like you to entertain such frivolus thoughts?

40009215.author: पदार्थः
40009215.content: मयापि I am also, भार्याविरहजम् due to separation from my wife, महत् great, व्यसनम् sorrow, प्राप्तम् shared, अहम् I am, एवम् in that way, न not शोचामि I am not brooding, धैर्यं च patience also, न परित्यजे  not given up

40009215.author: Translation
40009215.content: 'Separated from my wife, I, too, am afflicted with deep grief. But I do not brood, I do not lose patience.

40009216.author: पदार्थः
40009216.content: अहम् I am, प्राकृतः ordinary, वानरोऽपि सन् although a monkey, ताम् her (wife), न अनुशोचामि I do not brood, महात्मा च you are highsouled, विनीतश्च  humble, धृतिमान् endowed with patience, भवान् you, किं पुनः why (grieve) again.

40009216.author: Translation
40009216.content: 'I am an ordinary monkey born. Even then, I do not brood over my wife. You are highsouled, humble and patient. Why do you grieve?

40009217.author: पदार्थः
40009217.content: त्वम् you, आपतितम् streaming down, बाष्पम् tears, धैर्यात् with patience, निग्रहीतुम् to  restrain,  अर्हसि you ought to, सत्त्वयुक्तानाम् men endowed with equilibrium, मर्यादाम् mark, धृतिम् steadfastness, उत्स्रष्टुम् to deviate from, नार्हसि ought  not

40009217.author: Translation
40009217.content: 'Restrain the flow of your tears. Be  patient. Men (like you) endowed with  equilibrium and dignity and patience ought not to leave their composure.

40009218.author: पदार्थः
40009218.content: व्यसने वा in grief or, अर्थकृच्छ्रे वा or even over loss of wealth, जीवितान्तके at the hour of death, भये वा or in fear?, धृतिमान् one who is patient, स्वया बुद्ध्या by his own wisdom, विमृशन्  leaving, नावसीदति will not despair

40009218.author: Translation
40009218.content: 'In times of grief or loss of wealth or at the hour of death, one who is patient does not abandon his wisdom, he does not despair.

40009219.author: पदार्थः
40009219.content: यः नरः which man, बालिशः foolish, नित्यम् always, वैक्लब्यम् despair, अनुवर्तते gives in for, सः he, अवशं he loses selfcontrol, भाराक्रान्ता burdened, नौः boat, जले इव as in the water, शोके in grief, मज्जति gets sunk

40009219.author: Translation
40009219.content: A man who is unwise and distraught only gets sunk in grief like a heavily loaded boat (sinks) in water.

40009220.author: पदार्थः
40009220.content: मया by me, एषः this, अञ्जलिः folded palms, बद्धः is held, प्रणयात् out of friendship, त्वाम् you, प्रसादये be pleased, पौरुषम् manliness, श्रय you may take resort to, शोकस्य sorrow's, अन्तरम् a chance, दातुम् to give in, नार्हसि you ought not.

40009220.author: Translation
40009220.content: 'I implore you with folded palms on account of our friendship to show manliness. You should not give in to grief.

40009221.author: पदार्थः
40009221.content: ये those, शोकम् grief, अनुवर्तन्ते whoever give way, तेषाम् for them, सुखम् pleasure, न विद्यते is not there, तेषाम् for them, तेजश्च brilliance, क्षीयते is reduced, त्वम् you, शोचितुम् to grieve, नार्हसि ought not

40009221.author: Translation
40009221.content: 'There is no happiness for those who give way to sorrow. Their brilliance is dimmed. Therefore, you ought not grieve.

40009222.author: पदार्थः
40009222.content: शोकेन by grief, अभिप्रपन्नस्य who is overpowered, जीविते चापि even in life, संशयः doubt, राजेन्द्र O king, सः he, शोकम् sorrow, त्यज give up, केवलम् only, धैर्यम् patience, आश्रय seek shelter

40009222.author: Translation
40009222.content: 'Even the chances of survival are doubtful for a man who is overpowered by sorrow. Give up sorrow and have patience, O king

40009223.author: पदार्थः
40009223.content: वयस्यतां friendly concern, पूजयन्मे offering you, हितम् ब्रूमि I am speaking, ते to you, नोपदिशामि I do not advise, मे my, वयस्यताम् friendship, पूजयन् honouring, त्वम् you, शोचितुम् to grieve, न अर्हसि you ought not to

40009223.author: Translation
40009223.content: 'Out of friendly concern I offer my opinion in your interest. I am not competent to advise you. Respecting my friendship, you should never yield to grief.'

40009224.author: पदार्थः
40009224.content: तेन सुग्रीवेण by  Sugriva, मधुरम् sweet, सान्त्वितः comforted, सः राघवः that Rama, अश्रुपरिक्लिन्नम् wet with tears, मुखम् face, वस्त्रान्तेन with the hem of his upper cloth, प्रमार्जयत् wiped

40009224.author: Translation
40009224.content: Consoled by the sweet words of Sugriva, Rama wiped his face filled with tears by the hem of his upper cloth.

40009225.author: पदार्थः
40009225.content: प्रभुः Lord , काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, सुग्रीववचनात् by the words of Sugriva, प्रकृतिस्थः he became composed, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, सम्परिष्वज्य after embracing, इदं वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् he spoke

40009225.author: Translation
40009225.content: When lord Rama, the scion of the Kakutstha race was comforted by these words of Sugriva, he came to his senses, and clasping him said:

40009226.author: पदार्थः
40009226.content: सुग्रीव O Sugriva, स्निग्धेन by a loving, हितेन च and by a wellwisher, वयस्येन by a friend, यत् whatever, कर्तव्यं duty, अनुरूपं suitable, युक्तम् proper, तत् that, त्वया by you, कृतम् done

40009226.author: Translation
40009226.content: 'O Sugriva you have done what a friend should have done in a befitting manner with your sweet words and good wishes.

40009227.author: पदार्थः
40009227.content: सखे O friend, त्वया by you, अनुनीतः counselled by you, एषः अहम् that way I am, प्रकृतिस्थः come back to the senses, ईदृशः such, बन्धुः friend, दुर्लभः हि is difficult to find, अस्मिन् काले this time, विशेषतः specially

40009227.author: Translation
40009227.content: 'O friend you have guided me back to my senses thus. It is difficult to find a friend like you specially at this time.

40009228.author: पदार्थः
40009228.content: किं तु but, त्वया by you, मैथिल्याः Maithili's, दुरात्मनः of the evilminded, राक्षसस्य demon's, रौद्रस्य of the fierce, रावणस्य Ravana's, परिमार्गणे in tracing, यत्नः effort, कार्यः do

40009228.author: Translation
40009228.content: 'Indeed, you must make effort to trace the princess from Mithila and the evilminded, fierce  demon Ravana.

40009229.author: पदार्थः
40009229.content: मया by me, यत् that, अनुष्ठेयम् to be done, तत् that, विस्रब्धेन without any hesitation, उच्यताम् it may be, तव your, सर्वम् everything, वर्षासु in the rainy season, सुक्षेत्रे इव in a fertile land, सम्पद्यते it will produce good results.

40009229.author: Translation
40009229.content: 'Now tell me about my duty without any hesitation. I assure you that your desire will be fulfilled, just as seeds sown in a fertile land with timely rains bear fruit.

40009230.author: पदार्थः
40009230.content: हरिशार्दूल O tiger among monkeys, मया by me too, अभिमानात् out of injured honour, यत् those words, इदम् these, वाक्यम् words, समीरितुम् have been uttered, तत् that, त्वया by you, तत्त्वम् इति appropriately, उपधार्यताम् it may be treated so

40009230.author: Translation
40009230.content: 'O tiger amongst monkeys accept my words uttered out of injured honour in their true sense.

40009231.author: पदार्थः
40009231.content: मे by me, अनृतम् lies, न उक्तपूर्वम् never said earlier, कदाचन at any time, न वक्ष्ये च I will not tell also, एतत् this, ते to you, प्रतिजानामि I promise, अहम् I am, सत्येनैव by truth alone, च and, ते शपामि I swear

40009231.author: Translation
40009231.content: 'I have never uttered a false word earlier nor will I do it in future. This is my promise. I swear by truth alone.'

40009232.author: पदार्थः
40009232.content: ततः then, सचिवैः with his counsellers, वानरैः सह with monkeys, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, राघवस्य Raghava's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, विशेषतः specially, प्रतिज्ञातम् his own promise, प्रहृष्टः felt glad

40009232.author: Translation
40009232.content: Sugriva and his counsellors felt glad on hearing Rama's words, particularly  the assurance given by him.

40009233.author: पदार्थः
40009233.content: ततः then, एवम् that way, एकान्तसम्पृक्तौ meeting in private, तौ both, नरवानरौ a man and a monkey (Rama and Sugriva), उभौ both, अन्योन्यसदृशम् in a mutually befitting manner, सुखदुःखम् joy and sorrow, अभाषताम् spoke to each other

40009233.author: Translation
40009233.content: Man and monkey then met privately and shared the weal and woe of one another.

40009234.author: पदार्थः
40009234.content: विद्वान् wise man, सः he, हरिवीरमुख्यः chief of monkeys, हरिः monkey, महानुभावस्य of the magnanimous, तस्य his, नृपाणाम् of kings, रुषभस्य of the bull among men, वचः words, निशम्य after listening, तदा then, कार्यम् task, कृतम् achieved, हृदयेन at heart, मेने he thought

40009234.author: Translation
40009234.content: Wise Sugriva, chief of monkeys, heard the words of the magnanimous Rama, a bull among men. He felt glad at heart thinking that his task has been achieved. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे सप्तमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventh sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by the sage Valmiki.
